market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.1m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Venezuela crude production reported at ~1.095 mbpd in March 2026 per OPEC sources. Just 5 kbpd from the 1.1m threshold with 9 more months of OPEC reports remaining (Apr-Dec 2026). Likely to print >=1.1 in at least one month given recent uptrend.
assessment.key_uncertainty: US-Venezuela political situation and any sanctions changes.
